about_the_game:
Do you wish to support the continuous development of Songs of Silence?

Then check out this DLC! 

Purely cosmetic, it will give us - your humble dev team - additional backing.

The Supporter Upgrade grants you the harp hero frame. It will appear ...

  • On the strategy map, around your hero icon and the turn wheel.

  • In all game modes, campaign, scenarios and skirmish.

  • In the skirmish hero selection menu, for both single- & multiplayer.

By purchasing this upgrade, you are supporting the ongoing development of Songs of Silence. The hero frame is just a small token of our gratitude!

We are deeply thankful for all the support we've received up until now. Whether during our Kickstarter, Early Access or since 1.0 release. The many comments and reviews we receive help up shape Songs of Silence daily.

We're committed to improving the game for as long as possible. And we couldn't do it without you.

Thank you for being part of our journey.

The Chimera Team
